component.name: 9-zip
component.summary: Archive manager with the self-healing .9z format

description.p: 9-zip is a free archive manager. It looks and works like a classic two-pane archiver: browse your folders, open archives like folders, and add, extract and test files with a few clicks.
It creates 10 formats: 9Z, 7Z, ZIP, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, ZSTD, LZ4 and BROTLI. Its own .9z format adds three features:

ul.li: Self-healing: Reed-Solomon recovery data repairs damaged blocks automatically
Smart-adaptive: solid LZMA2 for text and code, while photos and videos are stored as they are
VSA Integrity Seal: every file is checked against its SHA-256 fingerprint

description.p: Also included: AES-256 encryption for 7z and zip, CRC and SHA checksums, a compression benchmark, and favorite folders.
